findings.message: The selection param avisoVencimentoId had no public selection method. Added selectAvisoVencimento(id | null), which publishes selectedAvisoVencimento (URL only) and fetches the record through qryAvisoPorId.

qryListarMeusAvisos filters by dataInicio and dataFim but no state holds them. Added filtroDataInicio and filtroDataFim with setFiltroDataInicio and setFiltroDataFim, and qryListarMeusAvisos accepts them as arguments.
qryAvisoPorId returns 'aviso' but no state has it as its source. Its output replaces avisoAtual, which feeds avisoDoDia. Clearing the selection (null) leaves avisoAtual as it was.
